highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.151.0-unreleased adds Vulkan via Silk.NET, fixes a memory leak, and broadens containerized platform support.
highlights_body: A new SkiaSharp.Vulkan.Silk.NET package brings hardware-accelerated Vulkan rendering on Android and Linux. A CoTaskMem pixel-buffer leak in the SKImage raster failure path is fixed. Performance improvements land in SKRuntimeEffectUniforms and SKTextBlob text encoding. Community contributor @jeffska adds FreeType-based font support for Nano Server.

bullets.detail: Stability and correctness patches from the Skia team's chrome/m151 branch have been merged, keeping the bundled engine current with upstream.

bullets.lead: CoTaskMem pixel-buffer leak fixed in SKImage raster failure path
bullets.detail: When SKImage.Create failed to create a raster image, the CoTaskMem-allocated pixel buffer was not freed. The leak has been fixed.

bullets.lead: Managed-code performance improvements in hot paths
bullets.detail: GetEncodedText avoids an intermediate string allocation in its null-terminated path, and SKRuntimeEffectUniforms pre-sizes its uniform lookup map to the known count, reducing allocations on the hot path.

bullets.lead: New SkiaSharp.Vulkan.Silk.NET package for hardware-accelerated Vulkan rendering
bullets.detail: A new package integrates Vulkan via the Silk.NET bindings, enabling GPU-accelerated rendering on Android and Linux. Vulkan visual tests now run on both platforms in CI.

bullets.lead: FreeType font support on Nano Server
bullets.detail: SkiaSharp now uses FreeType for font rendering on Windows Nano Server, resolving a long-standing limitation where fonts were unavailable in that container environment.

bullets.lead: Containerized CI test legs for Azure Linux, Alpine/musl, and Nano Server
bullets.detail: New Docker-based CI legs validate SkiaSharp on Azure Linux, Alpine Linux (musl libc), and Windows Nano Server, broadening the set of supported container environments.
